name: Tool: Order Status Lookup
author: Knotarium
description: A tiny, self-contained workflow meant to be used as a TOOL by the 'AI Agent: Order Concierge' template. It takes an orderId and returns a canned shipping status on the 'orderStatus' variable. Install this, publish + enable it, then open the Order Concierge agent node and pick this workflow under Tools. Replace the canned status with a real HTTP or DB lookup to make it live.
